$comment: Oil adjustment system. Every food declares an `oilSensitivity` level. The macros stored on a food are the BASE values measured at the `baseStyle` cooking style (home_style). Selecting a different style adds/removes cooking oil per 100g of food using the grams below. Resolver: addedOilGrams = oilGramsPer100g[style] * (servingGrams/100); fat += addedOilGrams; calories += addedOilGrams * kcalPerGramOil. A food may override these defaults with its own `oilModifiers` object (same shape as a sensitivity level entry).

styles.name: Very Light Oil
styles.description: Steamed, air-fried, or minimal oil (≈1 tsp or less).

styles.name: Home Style
styles.description: Typical home cooking. This is the baseline the stored macros represent.

styles.name: Dhaba Style
styles.description: Heavily tempered dhaba cooking with floating oil.

none.$note: No cooking oil applies (raw, boiled, steamed, fruit, milk, plain rice). Style selection has no effect.

low.$note: Lightly cooked items: dals, plain sabzi, tikki. Small oil swings.

high.$note: Rich gravies, paneer/meat curries, parathas. Large oil swings.

fried.$note: Deep-fried items (pakora, puri, samosa). Oil is intrinsic; very_light cannot remove much.
